trustDomain.description: The mesh trust domain, used to build workload identities.

namePrefix.description: Optional prefix for every generated object name.

defaultDeny.description: Deny all traffic not allowed by a rule, per direction.

allowSameNamespace.description: Allow all traffic between pods in this namespace.

allowDNS.description: Allow egress from every pod to the dns destination.

sources.description: Overrides of predefined sources, and custom sources.

destinations.description: Overrides of predefined destinations, and custom destinations.

ingress.description: Ingress rules, keyed by target workload.

egress.description: Egress rules, keyed by source workload.
